1879064142.name: Make Haste
1879064142.desc: Increases the movement speed of the Fellowship.

1879064398.name: Stance: Strength
1879064398.desc: When active, increases damage of shots.\n\nQuick Shot slows enemy movement speed.

1879073358.name: Quick Shot: Flaming Arrow
1879073358.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879073486.name: Hobbit-resilience
1879073486.desc: You can raise your Fellowship's Hope value through good old-fashioned hobbit-cheer. This does not stack with other Hope buffs.

1879073614.name: Dwarf-endurance
1879073614.desc: You provide a bonus to your Fellowship's Vitality.

1879073742.name: Poison Spray
1879073742.desc: You can spit a crippling poison in a spray, hitting enemies in front of you up to a short distance away.

1879104846.name: Fell Restoration
1879104846.desc: When finished casting, Fell Restoration instantly restores a huge amount of health to target.

1879115214.name: Goad
1879115214.desc: Goads nearby targets to attack the Warden.

1879136206.name: Brawler's Stance
1879136206.desc: You focus on damaging your opponents.

1879138638.name: Anointing of the Slick Flesh
1879138638.desc: A coating of slick mud provides protection against critical attacks and helps ease the sting of ill effects on yourself.

1879197902.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Raven)
1879197902.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879213902.name: The Stroke of Midnight (Melee)
1879213902.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879216334.name: True Heroics
1879216334.desc: Restores your power and decreases your attack duration while forcing all surrounding enemies to attack you.

1879233358.name: Ranged Exultation of Battle
1879233358.desc:
Wardens find strength in the sure knowledge that they are fighting to defend the defenceless.
Drains significant morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879242318.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879242318.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline allows the Lore-master to become the true master of knowledge and gain complete understanding of the world and how it works, supplying them with their most potent arsenal of abilities.

1879243982.name: Cry Havoc
1879243982.desc: A damaging cry that has the potential to truly disrupt your enemies and inspire you and your allies.

1879244238.name: Trick: Stratagem
1879244238.desc: A good Burglar knows how to plan for any situation and how to apply their knowledge to the best outcome at all times.

1879244878.name: Clash of Steel and Will
1879244878.desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore morale to you and your war-steed.

1879248334.name: Coda of the Eorlingas
1879248334.desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a powerful and effective heal for you and up to eight friendly targets nearby.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879255502.name: Serrated Edge
1879255502.desc: The initial impact of your weapon is meant to injure your foe, but the true damage is unleashed as you drag your weapon across your foe's flesh.

1879286478.name: Trap - Tripwire
1879286478.desc: The tripwire will knockdown enemies making them more vulnerable to attacks and easier for allies to land critical hits on them.

1879301198.name: Wintertide Steed
1879301198.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879302606.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Footsoldier)
1879302606.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879305550.name: Upshot
1879305550.desc: This attack does additional damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879316046.name: Slash
1879316046.desc: Slash a single target and generate Wrath. Has a chance to place a healing buff on the Beorning.

1879335502.name: Swan-knight Rider
1879335502.desc: Summons a Swan-knight Rider of Dol Amroth to keep you company.

1879344462.name: Farmer Maggot's Dog
1879344462.desc: Though excellent at guarding crops, this fellow is not very good in true combat situations. Still, he provides pleasant company.

1879345102.name: Steed of Elessar's Host
1879345102.desc: A token of thanks for your actions before the Battle of the Black Gate.

1879368654.name: White Peahen
1879368654.desc: Brings out a white peahen to keep you company.

1879381582.name: Black Mastiff
1879381582.desc: Brings out a black mastiff to keep you company.

1879426382.name: Plant Feet
1879426382.desc: Commit yourself to a spot on the battlefield.\n\nCreates a small hotspot at your feet. While standing in the hotspot, periodically gain an increasing mitigation buff and Mettle.

1879466446.name: Bastion of Light
1879466446.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879492174.name: Ambush
1879492174.desc: You compel your allies to ambush your enemies, improving speed and aggression for as long as they can maintain the element of surprise.

1879496910.name: Guise of a Goblin Corsair
1879496910.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of a goblin Corsair. Pulling from an assortment of Corsair paraphernalia, you feel ready to loot every kind of treat!

1879508558.name: Terror of the Caverns
1879508558.desc: Summons a terrifying bird to accompany you on your travels.

1879514062.name: Dark Grey Goat
1879514062.desc: A little goat who would like to see the world with you.

1879524430.name: Maramam's Bacon Pie Bauble
1879524430.desc: You are known to really enjoy these pies.

1879526094.name: Timeless Elf-hawk
1879526094.desc: Summons a noble hawk to accompany you on your travels.

1879528270.name: Prepared: Shadow Breath
1879528270.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of living shadow upon your foes.

1879528398.name: Clear Mind
1879528398.desc: Remove your sorcerous studies so that you may begin anew.

1879529166.name: Test Target Radial
1879529166.desc: This is a radial AoE skill centered on the target with limited targets.
